The '''Cadavine sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Cadavine included [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]] and [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]].

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' said [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]] was the recently established capital of the Cadavine sector. However, the later source ''[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]'' placed it in the [[Videnda sector/Legends|Videnda sector]]. Leland Chee has confirmed that for the time being, the original placement in the Cadavine sector is incorrect, and the latter placement is considered [[canon]].<ref name="SWBoards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=118855&start=30#3929926|thread=Galaxy Map Discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2003-05-28|time=9:28 AM|quote=For the time being, we are disregarding the placement of Dorvalla in the Cadavine sector as described in the Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook (which also misspelled 'Zhar' as 'Zahr.') As far as I know, there are no intentions to expand upon whether a second Dorvalla exists or not.}}</ref>
